title: FX Core (F-Core)
summary: Effects by intent: say what a sound is for (a build-up, an intro, an impact) and FCore does the rest.
steps: Choose the intent: what the sound is for in the song.
Choose the style: it changes how the intent is done, never what you can pick.
Turn the four knobs: Amount (how much), Length (how long it moves), Tone (dark or bright), Space (dry or huge).
Switch off a part you do not want (the small switches): the sentence on top says what is left.
On a sampler, the movement starts at every note; as an effect, it runs over the regions you mark.

On a build-up, + Add step has three extras for the end: Darker before the drop, Reverb before the drop, and Freeze at the end (everything stays where it got to, the note held, so you can put more effects after it).

examples.title: A build-up before the drop
examples.text: Intent Build-up, Length 32 beats: the sound opens and rises for 8 bars, then drops back.

examples.title: A soft intro
examples.text: Intent Intro, Tone low and Space high: far away and dark, it comes closer.

examples.title: One big hit
examples.text: Intent Impact on a crash or an impact sample: a short, wide hit at the start of a section.

examples.title: Freeze into the drop
examples.text: Preset Freeze into the drop: it rises, gets darker with a big reverb in the last bars, and holds there until the drop. Add SPACE or any effect after it.

styles.why: Short, fast movements that keep up with the tempo.
Slow, long movements and big spaces.
